development.cv: Synthetic candidate. During a supervised internship I added request validation to a small booking API. I wrote tests for missing fields and reviewed failures with a mentor. Deployment decisions belonged to the mentor.
development.principles: HTTP idempotence concerns the intended server effect of repeating a request. Tests should cover relevant failure cases. Ask for missing assumptions and acknowledge limited deployment experience.

responsibilities: Own service reliability and review trade-offs

development.cv: Candidato sintetico. Ho coordinato la revisione di una API di prenotazione dopo richieste duplicate. Ho scelto una chiave di idempotenza persistita e verificato i casi di timeout con il team. La decisione finale sul prodotto spettava al responsabile prodotto.
development.principles: Distinguish intended effects from response identity. Retry and concurrent duplicate handling require explicit assumptions; avoid exactly-once guarantees without boundaries.
Distinguish nominal changes from price-adjusted changes. Check the period, population and price index. Do not claim causality from correlation or invent research experience.

development.cv: Synthetic candidate. I led a descriptive regional-price briefing. I selected comparable periods and documented missing observations. I presented uncertainty and alternative deflators; the briefing did not identify a causal policy effect.
development.principles: Price indices measure different baskets and concepts. State identification assumptions before causal claims; distinguish a descriptive association from an estimated causal effect. Consider sensitivity and data revisions.

responsibilities: Recognise deterioration and seek senior help

development.cv: Synthetic candidate. In supervised simulation training I practised structured handover for a deteriorating adult. I gathered observations and escalated concern to the supervising clinician. I have not independently managed critically ill patients.
development.principles: Recognise own limits, assess urgency, gather observations and escalate promptly. Do not invent diagnoses, drug doses or independent clinical authority. Use local protocols and senior supervision for management decisions.

development.cv: Candidato sintetico. Ho guidato una simulazione di consegna clinica con specializzandi. Ho assegnato raccolta dei parametri e comunicazione delle priorità, poi discusso omissioni e limiti della simulazione. Non sono disponibili esiti clinici reali.
development.principles: Coordinate assessment and resources, keep uncertainty explicit, delegate within competence and verify closed-loop handover. Do not invent clinical outcomes or definitive treatment without context.

development.cv: Candidato sintetico. In un tirocinio ho aggiornato un registro ordini e segnalato ritardi al supervisore. Ho confrontato conferme e date promesse prima di preparare gli aggiornamenti per i clienti. Non decidevo sconti o compensazioni.
development.principles: Check facts and commitments, distinguish urgency from impact, escalate decisions outside authority and avoid promising unverified delivery dates.

responsibilities: Own exception priorities and customer commitments
Coordinate teams and review process outcomes

development.cv: Synthetic candidate. I coordinated a backlog review across sales and fulfilment. I introduced a shared exception log and assigned owners for customer updates. I compared unresolved cases weekly; no quantified revenue effect was measured.
development.principles: Make constraints and authority explicit. Balance impact, urgency and fairness. Verify commitments before promising them, assign owners and check outcomes rather than claiming unmeasured improvements.

independent.cv: Synthetic candidate. During mentored practice I used short exit questions to identify a misconception in fractions. I adapted the next explanation with my mentor and checked pupils' reasoning. I have not led whole-school curriculum decisions.
independent.principles: Assess the gap in understanding before deciding feedback. Give actionable feedback and time for pupils to use it. A preferred written or verbal format does not itself guarantee learning.

independent.cv: Candidato sintetico. Ho coordinato con colleghi una revisione delle domande di verifica sulle frazioni. Ho confrontato errori ricorrenti e organizzato un confronto sulle strategie di feedback. Non abbiamo isolato un effetto causale sui risultati della scuola.
independent.principles: Feedback should address a diagnosed learning gap and be usable by pupils. Consider workload, implementation and evidence quality rather than mandating one format. Do not invent measured attainment gains.

independent.cv: Candidato sintetico. Durante un tirocinio ho registrato difetti di un lotto dimostrativo e raccolto misure con il supervisore. Ho mantenuto distinti prodotti verificati e non verificati. Non autorizzavo il rilascio dei lotti.
independent.principles: Separate containment from explaining and eliminating causes. A plausible cause is a hypothesis requiring evidence. Respect traceability and delegated authority; do not invent certification or release rights.

independent.cv: Synthetic candidate. I coordinated an investigation of recurring dimensional defects on a demonstration line. I compared measurement records across process conditions and assigned checks to process owners. We had not completed the effectiveness review at the time of the handover.
independent.principles: Distinguish immediate containment, cause investigation and corrective-action effectiveness. Test competing causes using process evidence; absence of a defect in a small follow-up sample is not proof that recurrence is impossible.
